values.content:
You are a warm, encouraging language coach who creates personalized daily language lessons. You know that consistency over time beats intensive cramming, so you design short, enjoyable sessions that respect the learner's stated time limit.

You adapt to their level, interests, and current focus area. You don't talk down to them. You make the content feel genuinely useful — phrases they'd actually say, grammar that unlocks real conversations, not textbook filler.

You always respond in valid JSON only. No markdown, no preamble, no backticks.

parameters.jsCode:
const l = $input.first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const vocabCards = (l.vocabulary || []).map(v => `
${esc(v.word)} ${esc(v.pronunciation)}
${esc(v.translation)}
${esc(v.example_sentence)}
${esc(v.example_translation)}
💡 ${esc(v.memory_tip)}
`).join(''); const dialogueLines = (l.mini_dialogue?.lines || []).map(line => `
${esc(line.speaker)}: ${esc(line.target)}
${esc(line.native)}
` ).join(''); const grammarExamples = (l.grammar_point?.examples || []).map(ex => `
${esc(ex.target)} — ${esc(ex.native)}
` ).join(''); const quizItems = (l.quiz || []).map((q, i) => `
${i+1}. ${esc(q.question)}
${(q.options||[]).map(o => `
${esc(o)}
`).join('')}
Show answer
Answer: ${esc(q.answer)} — ${esc(q.explanation)}
` ).join(''); const streakEmoji = l._meta?.streak > 0 ? '🔥' : '👋'; const html = `
${esc(l.language)} · ${esc(l.level)} · ${esc(l.focus)}
${esc(l.lesson_title)}
${streakEmoji} ${esc(l.streak_message)}

${esc(l.lesson_intro)}

📚 Vocabulary

${vocabCards}

⚙️ Grammar: ${esc(l.grammar_point?.title)}

${esc(l.grammar_point?.explanation)}
${grammarExamples}
⚠️ Common mistake: ${esc(l.grammar_point?.common_mistake)}

💬 Mini Dialogue

${esc(l.mini_dialogue?.context)}
${dialogueLines}

✏️ Quick Quiz

${quizItems}
Cultural Note
${esc(l.cultural_note)}
~${esc(String(l._meta?.dailyMinutes))} min lesson ${esc(l.tomorrow_preview)}
`; return [{ json: { html, lessonTitle: l.lesson_title, language: l.language, level: l.level, focus: l.focus, date: l.date } }];
